entry_points.text: Direct MSR/PMC access: inline WRMSR installs u64, native read returns u64 with trace, safe write returns 0/errno with trace, PMC read by index, trace helper no-op here.
Split helpers convert u64 to/from EDX:EAX halves; unsafe read/write direct, safe variants store via pointers and return status; PMC helper forwards index.

exports.text: Single-CPU fallback ignores CPU/mask, operates on CPU0; read/write on CPUs use per-CPU slot, safe variants forward status.
Without MTRR, management is inert: add/delete return -ENODEV, trim returns 0, others no-op.

MSR write splits 64b across EDX:EAX with index in ECX plus memory ordering; unsafe read/write use exception-table fixup, safe returns status.

invariants.text: MSR trace subsystem=msr include=msr-trace path=asm with dedicated guard.
MSR and MTRR headers use once-only path-keyed guards.
Single-bit masks equal 1 shifted by the named BIT index.
MSR trace gating and per-CPU fallbacks rely on external trace-enabled and per-CPU helpers.

structs.text: msr_info holds u32 reg plus value, per-CPU values pointer and error; msr_regs_info holds reg array pointer plus error; saved_msr pairs valid plus snapshot; saved_msrs pairs count plus array.
